title: How a bridge is usually made
lead: A bridge uses the teeth either side of the gap. An implant stands on its own and does not touch them.

steps.label: Shape the neighbours
steps.words: The teeth either side of the gap are smoothed a little, with the area numbed, so the bridge can fit over them.

steps.label: Fit the bridge
steps.words: A new tooth, joined to a cap on each neighbour, is fitted and checked for your bite.
